name: todo-webapp
description: Single-page React app for the collaborative to-do list product: sign-in, list creation, invitation and membership management, and task CRUD with sort/filter by due date or priority. Talks only to todo-api; holds no direct database credentials.

dependencies.name: todo-api
dependencies.description: Fetches and mutates the signed-in user's lists, memberships, invitations, and tasks.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs the user in via OIDC + PKCE and supplies the access token attached to every todo-api call.
